parts.text: Hi, my order CYM-EC-1002 hasn't shown up yet. Can you look into it?
The order is delayed by the winter storm. As a Platinum tier customer, issue a $100 credit and a Next-Day Air shipping upgrade, then apologize and explain the delay.
My order CYM-EC-9921 was supposed to arrive already. What happened?
The order is delayed by the winter storm. As a Gold tier customer, issue a $50 credit and a Next-Day Air shipping upgrade, then apologize and explain the delay.
Can you check on order CYM-EC-1003 for me? It's late.
The order is delayed by the winter storm. As a Silver tier customer, issue a $25 credit and a 3-Day Select shipping upgrade, then apologize and explain the delay.
Order CYM-EC-1004 is late, what's going on and what can you do about it?
The order is delayed by the winter storm. As a Member tier customer, issue a $10 credit and a Priority Shipping upgrade, then apologize and explain the delay.
I want to check the status of order CYM-EC-1001, is it delayed?
No compensation should be issued: the order has already been delivered and was not delayed by the storm, so it does not qualify under the disruption compensation policy.
Can you check my order CYM-EC-9999? I think it's stuck somewhere.
No compensation should be issued: the order was not found in the system, so the agent must say so and must not fabricate order details or issue compensation.
